$comment: Bootstrap orchestrator config (development-time only; PLAN §11). Edit freely. Nothing here is shipped product code.

cards.$comment: Aptitude hints Jev ranks against. Registry facts from ~/.pi/agent/models.json; aptitude text is editable and advisory.
cards.claude-fable-5-1: Claude family, 128K context, no image input. Aptitudes: careful long-form writing, specifications, ADRs, documentation with precise structure.
cards.claude-opus-5: Claude family, 128K context, no image input. Aptitudes: deep reasoning, novel design, subtle concurrency and security logic, large refactors. Slowest of the Claude family.
cards.claude-sonnet-5: Claude family, 128K context, no image input. Aptitudes: general TypeScript implementation, tests, tool use, fast turnaround on standard feature work.
cards.gpt-5.5: GPT family, 272K context, image input. Aptitudes: large-context work across many files, standard implementation, reading long docs.
cards.gpt-5.6-luna: GPT family, 272K context, image input. Aptitudes: unrated beyond family traits (large context, broad coding).
cards.gpt-5.6-sol: GPT family, 272K context, image input. Aptitudes: unrated beyond family traits (large context, broad coding).
cards.gpt-5.6-terra: GPT family, 272K context, image input. Aptitudes: unrated beyond family traits (large context, broad coding).
cards.gpt-6-astra: GPT family, 272K context, image input, always reasons (no 'off'). Aptitudes: hardest reasoning and design problems; most expensive in time.
cards.kimi-k3: Kimi family, 128K context. Aptitudes: unrated; reasonable general coding.
cards.zai-glm-5.3: GLM family, 128K context. Aptitudes: unrated; reasonable general coding.

policy.$comment: merge: 'never' (open PRs only, human merges) | 'jev-review' (after the evidence gate passes, run the merge review: hard checks + Jev complete/honest/in-scope/violation/quality; squash-merge only if all pass, otherwise needs-human). Never merges risk:high.
